scope: Reviewer Detail only, plus necessary shared state/routing and regression updates. No Revision Journey implemented.
verificationStatus: Automated checks passed; feature is NOT fully verified.
functionalFeatures: Queue primary links navigate to the matching Reviewer Detail; return links preserve queue filters.
Read-only exact submitted copy and revision-owned creator/brand/targeting/timestamps.
Simulated findings, severity, explanations, rule/source excerpts and evidence drawer.
Shared SourceEvidence component reused by Content Check and Reviewer Detail.
Approval requires confirmation capturing the displayed revision ID and optional comment.
Request Changes requires a trimmed nonempty reviewer comment.
Completed, superseded and noncurrent revisions cannot receive repeated decisions.
Shared queue status, summary, approved timestamp and sidebar pending count update after decisions.
Approved content/evidence/metadata and comments are preserved; edited resubmission creates a new pending revision.
Submission and decision history events are stored for future Revision Journey work.
Earlier snapshots can be viewed read-only.
Loading, empty, success, error, retry and stale-confirmation handling.

stateSemantics.storage: In-memory only; full reload/tab separation resets the demo.
stateSemantics.immutability: Internal records are deeply frozen; service loads return isolated copies with readonly revision contracts. Creator working-copy changes cannot mutate stored approved revisions.
stateSemantics.newRevisions: Changed resubmission appends a revision to the same submission. Identical pending submissions are idempotent; unchanged completed submissions cannot reopen a review.
stateSemantics.concurrency: Mock decisions atomically validate expected current revision ID and pending status after asynchronous delay.
stateSemantics.history: Decision events include submission/revision IDs, revision number, actor, timestamp and stored comment.

validation.note: Two existing queue opening expectations were adapted to the required detail route; legacy preview coverage retained.

liveValidation.reason: Frontend-only mock scope; no backend, database, authentication or AI service integration.

unverified: Pixel-level visual fidelity and responsive rendering
Native dialog focus trapping/restoration and keyboard behavior in actual browsers
Remote asset/image loading and actual downloads
Real API authorization, concurrency and persistence

integrationAssumptions: Implement ReviewerDetailService separately from UI; use authoritative revision-specific snapshots.
Backend must atomically reject stale/completed decisions, enforce reviewer identity/permissions and require change-request comments.
Backend must retain immutable text, evidence and asset versions plus decision history.
After a successful decision, adapters must invalidate/notify the queue snapshot as the shared mock session does.
limitations: Remote creative files referenced in Stitch are not supplied locally; cards show unavailable-file placeholders.
Title-only queue fixtures receive explicitly fictional copy at session initialization. Creator submissions retain their actual submitted text.
Compare Diff, Reject Campaign and dual-sign dispatch remain disabled/outside scope.
No cryptographic verification or regulatory compliance guarantee is claimed.

costs.note: Agent billing is not exposed by this environment.

callCounts.note: Mock invocation counts are not instrumented. All automated service/DOM tests run locally.

cache.dependencies: Existing node_modules and workspace npm cache reused; no dependencies installed in this step
cache.application: Shared in-memory session, no persistent cache/database
